title: Hospital cash deposit (first admission)
summary: Private or restructured hospital asking for a five-figure deposit before admission — map what Integrated Shield / employer plans actually pre-authorise, what you must float in cash, and how to claw the deposit back after discharge.

sections.title: Ask finance before you pack the overnight bag
sections.body: Singapore private and restructured hospitals routinely quote an admission deposit sized to the ward class and estimated length of stay. Expats on EP often assume “I have IP / company insurance” means zero cash — then meet a counter asking for $5k–$20k same day. Call the hospital’s admissions / patient finance line with the procedure code and ward class before the booking is locked.
bullets: Get the deposit quote and accepted payment methods in writing (email / WhatsApp from finance)
Ask whether the deposit is per admission or per night estimate
Confirm whether a Letter of Guarantee (LOG) from insurer / employer can shrink or waive the cash hold

sections.title: Integrated Shield ≠ automatic deposit waiver
sections.body: An Integrated Shield Plan (IP) rider and a company Group Hospitalisation policy can each issue a Letter of Guarantee — but only after pre-authorisation, and only for covered benefits. Deductibles, co-insurance, non-panel surgeons, and waiting periods still leave a cash gap. Treat the deposit as working capital you may need for 2–6 weeks after discharge while claims settle.
bullets: Start pre-auth as soon as the admission date is known — not the morning of surgery
Ask whether the LOG covers deposit, final bill, or both
Keep a separate SGD buffer for outpatient follow-ups the LOG will not touch

sections.title: Payment rails: card limits, PayNow, and employer LOG
sections.body: Hospital counters often prefer Visa/Mastercard or PayNow to a hospital UEN. Foreign cards can fail 3-D Secure or hit issuer fraud blocks on five-figure holds. Test a smaller charge the day before if you must use an overseas card. Employer LOGs usually route through HR / the TPA portal — build that lead time into the admission week.
bullets: Confirm daily card limit with your bank before admission day
Save the hospital PayNow / UEN screenshot and receipt PDF
If HR is slow, ask finance whether a partial deposit holds the bed

sections.title: Discharge → final bill → deposit clawback
sections.body: After discharge the hospital issues a final bill, offsets the deposit, and refunds the remainder — or issues a top-up invoice. Refunds to foreign cards can take weeks; PayNow refunds are usually faster. Keep the admission deposit receipt; finance will ask for it if the refund stalls.
bullets: Photograph every receipt and the discharge summary before you leave the ward
Ask finance for the expected refund method and SLA in writing
If insurer pays the hospital direct, confirm you are not double-charged the deposit

sections.title: Dependant admissions — whose policy, whose cash
sections.body: A child’s or spouse’s admission still needs a paying party at the counter. Dependant Pass status does not create MediSave access the way a citizen/PR parent might expect. Confirm whether the child’s cover sits on the EP holder’s IP rider, a separate rider, or employer family cover — then size the cash deposit to the uncovered gap.
bullets: Do not assume MediSave can settle a foreigner’s private-hospital bill
Name the policyholder and LOG applicant before admission day
FDW / household helper admissions are a different product — see MOM helpers guidance

sections.title: Size a calm cash buffer
sections.body: Forum numbers swing wildly by hospital and ward. A practical orientation buffer for a planned private admission is often one quoted deposit plus a 20–30% contingency for upgrades, longer stay, or delayed LOG. Sketch household cash separately from rent and agent fees so admission week does not raid the lease deposit.
bullets: Hold the deposit in a SGD account you can PayNow from same day
Do not raid rent / agent-commission reserves for elective surgery
First-month cash tool is for housing LOI week — keep hospital float separate: /tools/setup-cash
